decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (S56HR-01/FP, 02/FP, 03/FP) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in either flank wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the property known as 56 Harewood Road. (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include kitchen facilities)
description: Retention of existing detached outbuilding comprising of a store and a gym in the rear end of the garden to the house
